What are the eligible purposes for transferring funds overseas?

Outward remittance is allowed for the following purposes:

Trade payment

Salary

Management fees

Air ticket fees

Loan principal & interest repayment

Tourism

Freight charges

Education fees

Export refunds

Dividend

Compensation

Medical expenses

Insurance premium

Liquidation

________________________________________

Are there any limitations on outward payment transactions?

Trade payments – No limit, provided all supporting documents are complete.

Non-trade payments – Require prior approval from FESC.

________________________________________

How long does it take for funds to reach overseas?

Non-trade payments – Require prior approval from FESC.

________________________________________

How long does it take for funds to reach overseas?

Depositary Correspondent Bank: Same day (T+0) if submitted before cut-off time.

After cut-off time: Next working day (T+1).

________________________________________

Can advance payments be remitted?

No, advance payments are not allowed.

________________________________________

Do I need to submit KYC documents for every transaction?

No. If you are a CB Bank account holder, you do not need to submit KYC documents for each transaction.

Only supporting documents relevant to the purpose of payment are required.

________________________________________

Can I remit funds if I don’t have a Foreign Currency (FCY) Account with CB Bank?

No. Customers must hold a Foreign Currency Account with CB Bank for overseas remittance.

________________________________________

When will my transaction be processed?

Requests received before 12:00 noon on a working day: Processed on the same day (if account balance, signature, and documents are complete).

Requests received after 12:00 noon: Processed on the next working day.

Requests received after 12:00 noon: Processed on the next working day.

Can a customer cancel a fund transfer request?

Yes, bank will try to do on a best-effort basis.

Requires a signed customer request letter.

Cancellation charge: USD 10 (or equivalent in MMK).

________________________________________

Can a customer amend a fund transfer request (e.g., beneficiary name, account number, address, or payment details)?

Yes, on a best-effort basis.

Requires a signed customer request letter.

Amendment charge: USD 10 (or equivalent in MMK).

________________________________________

What is CB Bank’s SWIFT Code?

CPOBMMMYXXX

What are the remittance charges for outward remittance?

Standard Remittance: 0.125% of remittance amount (minimum USD 25) + Cable Charges (MMK 3,000)

Amendment / Cancellation / Enquiry: USD 10 (or equivalent in MMK)

CNY 60 per transaction

THB 100 (up to 500,000)

To which countries can customers remit funds?

Customers can remit funds to countries where CB Bank has direct correspondent banking relationships (end-to-end transactions).

________________________________________

Mandatory Documents:

Q7. Can I transfer money from abroad into a Yuan account and keep it in my account? If not, what percentage must I sell through Online Trade?
A7.

Non-Trade Transactions:

If the company is registered under MIC, it is allowed to keep the funds.

If the company is not registered under MIC, it is not allowed to keep the funds. The full amount (100%) must be converted at the CBM rate (not the online rate).

Export Trade Transactions:

If the company is MIC-registered and the export commodity is agricultural or marine products, funds cannot be kept for more than one month. At least 25% must be sold upon credit to the account, while the remaining 75% may be sold at the online rate.

If the export commodity is not agricultural or marine products, funds may be retained.

If the company is a local entity, funds cannot be kept for more than one month. At least 25% must be sold upon credit to the account, while the remaining 75% may be sold at the online rate.

If the company is a local entity, funds cannot be kept for more than one month. At least 25% must be sold upon credit to the account, while the remaining 75% may be sold at the online rate.

Share and fund are settled in three business days after the order executed date excluding weekends and public holidays.

A market condition where stock prices are rising and investor confidence is high.

စတော့ဈေးနှုန်းများ တောက်လျှောက်တက်နေပြီး ရင်းနှီးမြှုပ်နှံသူများ ယုံကြည်မှု မြင့်မားနေသော ဈေးကွက် အခြေအနေဖြစ်သည်။

38. What is a "Bear Market"?

A market condition where stock prices are falling, encouraging selling.

စတော့ဈေးနှုန်းများ တောက်လျှောက်ကျဆင်းနေသော ဈေးကွက်အခြေအနေ ဖြစ်သည်။

39. What is "Volatility"?

The frequency and magnitude of price changes for a stock over a short period.

"Volatility" (ဈေးနှုန်းအတက်အကျမြန်ခြင်း) ဆိုသည်မှာ အဘယ်နည်း။

The unmatched quantity of the unmatched or partial matched orders will be expired at the end of the day. Only GTC/GTD orders will have been automatically placed the next day until it’s expired or cancelled.

(89) What is a "Contract Note"?

It is a legal document describing the prompt and clear delivery of the contract details to customer which includes date of the transaction, matter of purchase or sell, name of securities traded, traded quantity, traded price and commission fees (stamp duty fee will be included if it is buy order)

အရောင်းအဝယ်ဖြစ်သော နေ့ရက်၊ ဝယ်ယူခြင်း ရောင်းချခြင်း အကြောင်းအရာ၊ အရောင်း အဝယ်ဖြစ်သော အစုရှယ်ယာ၊ အစောင်ရေ၊ ဈေးနှုန်း နှင့် ဝန်ဆောင်ခ (အဝယ်အမှာစာ ဖြစ်ပါက တံဆိပ်ခေါင်းခွန်အပါ) စသည့် အကြောင်းအရာကို ဖော်ပြသော အရောင်းအဝယ် အသေးစိတ်ကို အတည်ပြုထားသည့် တရားဝင်စာရွက်စာတမ်း ဖြစ်သည်။

(92) What is the "Base Price"?

“Base price” is the price to determine the “upper and lower limit price” of the day. It is usually the closing price of the previous trading day. The price is not intended to mean a kind of predetermined or anticipated matching price.

(95) What is "Unrealized Profit or Loss"?

Unrealized gains or losses is the estimated profit or loss calculated on current market prices for the holding shares. Generally, it is also called paper profits or losses. It can be changed which may be either up or down until the share are actually sold.

လက်ဝယ်ရှိထားသော အစုရှယ်ယာများ၏ လက်ရှိဈေးကွက်ပေါက်ဈေးနှင့် ခန့်မှန်းတွက် ချက်ထားသော အမြတ် သို့မဟုတ် အရှုံး ဖြစ်သည်။ ယေဘုယျအားဖြင့် တွက်ချက်ထား သော အမြတ် သို့မဟုတ် အရှုံးဖြစ်ပြီး ရောင်းချခြင်းမပြုလုပ်မချင်း ဈေးအတက်/အကျ ရှိနိုင်ပါသည်။

(96) What is "Realized Profit/Loss"?

(96) What is "Realized Profit/Loss"?

"Realized Profit/Loss" ဆိုသည်မှာ အဘယ်နည်း။

E-commerce is a system for selling products and services on the websites by merchants so that VISA, Master (Debit/Credit) and MPU Card holders can buy those products and services from the websites.

What are the advantages of E-commerce?

By using E-commerce, customers can buy products from the websites at any time, reduce other expenses and save time. For merchants, E-commerce enables them to market worldwide and increase the sales.

What are the advantages of KBZ Payment Gateway?

Buyers can purchase with their VISA and Master Cards (Debit/Credit) from websites that have KBZ Payment Gateway and make safer payments as KBZ Payment Gateway uses 3D Secure System.

What is a Payment Gateway?

A payment gateway is a service that authenticates transactions between buyers and sellers online. When a buyer makes a purchase on a website, payment gateway checks the payment system of the buyer and authenticate the purchase. And payment gateway facilitates the transfer of money to the merchant’s bank account at a specified time. Thus, a payment gateway is a service that authenticates transactions between buyers and sellers online.

Export Bill Collection (DP/DA)

Service Description

To facilitate customers present the export documents to the importer’s collecting bank with instructions to handle documents for collecting export proceeds as per Uniform Rules for Collection (URC) issued by the ICC.

Two types of Documentary Collections:

1.Documents against Payment (D/P):

The importer receives the presented documents only after making payment to the Collecting Bank.

2.Documents against Acceptance (D/A):

The importer receives the presented documents only after making an acceptance of a Bill of Exchange and promises to make payment in a certain future date.

Service Benefits

A safer legal (URC covered) option to obtain payment of the bill from the Importer as compared to an open account or direct approach (outside Banking Channels)

Shipping documents will be released only as per payment terms for shipping documents that are not consigned to Order thereby ensuring that the goods remain in control of the presenting Bank/Exporter

Import Services

KBZ is your partner in helping your financing needs in import business and mitigating risks to ensure that you receive the goods once your payment is made. We invite you to explore our comprehensive range of import solutions in greater detail.

Import Letter of Credit Issuance

Service Description

Import LC is used to facilitate importers in Myanmar to purchase goods from overseas suppliers based on an agreement with the Exporter on the terms of their contract of trade. If the Exporter requires an LC to be opened in their favour, the Importer in Myanmar will have to arrange for one with its bank.

No requirement of Credit facility

Service Benefits

Import LC is the most secured payment method in international trade

Same day LC issuance service before daily cut off time.

Application form can be transmitted via the Customers’ registered email address with the Bank.

Documents Required

1. Commercial Letter of Credit Application Form(need to be affixed 200MMK special stamp)

2. Pro-forma Invoice and/or Sale Contract duly signed in acceptance by both the Buyer and Seller.

Local Letter of Credit Issuance

Service Description

This product is similar to that of Import letter of Credit. Such LCs are issued to facilitate local trade within Myanmar. Consequently, the shipping document will not be a bill of lading but a truck receipt or equivalent related to Local transportation practices that are consigned directly to the Buyer.

Service Benefits

A Local LC is a safer payment tool for local trading.

Same day LC issuance service before daily cut off time.

Application form can be transmitted via the Customers’ registered email address with the Bank.

Documents Required

1. Commercial Letter of Credit Application Form (need to be affixed 200MMK special stamp)

2. Pro-forma Invoice and/or Sale Contract duly signed in acceptance by both the Buyer and Seller.

Import Bill Collection (DP/DA)

Service Description

The Bank acts on behalf of the Buyer/Importer and is requested by the seller/exporter’s Bank to deliver export documents and collect payment in accordance with the instructions of the Seller/Exporter’s Bank.

Two types of Documentary Collections:

1.Documents against Payment Collection (D/P):

The importer receives the documents only after making payment.

2.Documents against Acceptance Collection (D/A):

Documents are delivered against acceptance of a Bill of Exchange or a promise of payment made by the importer.

Service Benefits

Delivery of documents can be taken upon payment of amount mentioned on the Bill presentment invoice.

Leverage the bank’s credibility to assure that the documents and underlying payment are properly handled.

Documents Required

1. KBZ Bank’s email notification of Bill documents arrival advice

2. Original Import license issued by Ministry of Commerce (or) Non-License undertaking with company letterhead

Trust Receipt Loan (TRL)

Service Description

TRL is a short-term finance to the Importer for clearance of goods shipped under an LC. Whilst the Title of the Goods remains with KBZ Bank, the Bank allows the Buyer to take possession of the Goods on Trust. The tenor of the TRL will be up to 180 days.

Need to apply for Trust Receipt Loan credit facility

Service Benefits

Importer is able to inject working capital into the Business by enabling clearance and sale of goods imported that essentially becomes stock in trade for the importer.

Documents Required

1. Company letter for TR Loan request (with letterhead)

2. TR Loan agreement duly executed;

3. Buyer’s accepted Bill of Exchange

How to apply?

NRC

Household Registration

Approval of Permanent Address

Po Su Fixed Deposit Account is suitable for customers who would like to make multiple fixed deposits for a longer tenor and earn a high interest rate.

Trust Services

Escrow Services and Accounts

KBZ Bank’s Escrow Service is a contractual arrangement to hold funds (or other assets) on behalf of two or more agreeing parties and to make payments as instructed when specific mutually agreed to conditions have been met.  Escrow Services can be used in many types of transactions including Capital Purchases and Contributions, Import/Export Transactions, Real Estate Transactions and Structured or Syndicated Loans.

A simple example would be if a Myanmar Importer wants to make a purchase from overseas but are not familiar with the Seller.  With the help of KBZ Trust Department, the two can enter into an Escrow Management Agreement where the Buyer will deposit the funds with KBZ, the seller will be notified of the funds on deposit, the seller will then ship the goods and once the conditions of the Agreement have been met, KBZ will transfer the funds to an account as instructed in the contract.

Security Trustee Service

MAB MMQR

MAB MMQR is a secure and efficient digital payment solution that allows merchants to accept QR payments from all MMQR-compliant mobile wallets and banking apps, fully aligned with the national MMQR standard issued by the Central Bank of Myanmar. It provides instant payment acceptance directly to the merchant’s MAB account, supports easy onboarding for all business types, and ensures a smooth and trusted digital payment experience for both merchants and customers.

What is ESBN?

The ESCAP Sustainable Business Network (ESBN) is a United Nations initiative that connects businesses across the Asia-Pacific region to collaborate on sustainable development and advance the UN 2030 Agenda. It brings together business leaders, policymakers, and innovators to promote inclusive, responsible, and green business practices that contribute to achieving the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

The ESBN Green Deal is a digital platform that helps companies measure, improve, and showcase their sustainability performance through data insights and assessment tools. Businesses, including those in Myanmar, can benefit by benchmarking their ESG performance, gaining international recognition through Green, Silver, or Gold badges, and accessing regional networks and resources that support sustainable growth, competitiveness, and global visibility

Easy, Four-Step Process

Easy, Four-Step Process

Our Home Loan Specialists will guide you through our easy application process and, most importantly, help you get the very best terms for your new loan.

1. Get pre-approval – Contact your nearest Yoma Bank branch to begin a discussion with our Home Loan Specialists about your loan needs. Together, we will determine what kind of loan is right for you, including the interest rate, down payment and monthly payments.

2. Find your new home – After determining what kind of loan you qualify for and acquiring a Home Loan proposition from Yoma Bank, start researching and exploring potential properties that fit your budget.

3. Contact the seller and prepare documentation – After finding your perfect home, contact the seller and begin filling out the required forms and documents.

4. Submit your application – Apply for your Home Loan by submitting the necessary documents at one of our Yoma Bank branches. Our Home Loan Specialists will proceed with the asset valuation, inspection of the property and your income statement. You can expect to hear a response from us within two to three weeks.

Deliverable Foreign Exchange Forward

A Deliverable Foreign Exchange Forward is a contract that protects customers against foreign exchange market risk by purchasing or selling foreign currency against Myanmar Kyat for later settlement at a predetermined rate. Deliverable this service can help you:

Focus on core business activities and reduce the need for monitoring foreign exchange fluctuations

Protect profit margins on imported and exported goods and services

Account for exchange rate fluctuations in budgeting and projections

Cross Currency Swap

Protect profit margins on imported and exported goods and services

Account for exchange rate fluctuations in budgeting and projections

Cross Currency Swap

In a Cross Currency Swap agreement, currency is not exchanged but temporarily swapped between bank and customer. This allows our customers to protect themselves against rate fluctuations by swapping one currency for another at current market rates with an agreement to re-swap later at a pre-agreed rate. Yoma Bank Cross Currency Swap is an effective tool for business with liabilities in one currency and revenue in another.

Currency Swap

A Currency Swap is similar to a Cross Currency Swap, but clients swap currency with a third party rather than with the bank directly. The currency is then re-swapped at a future date at a predetermined rate.
